study: Real TUJI1 phone and location transfer with finite labeled support
split: Each of five target-phone folds fits source references on all other phones' official training rows. Only N distinct positions from the target phone's official training rows are supplied for adaptation. Evaluation uses that target phone's official testing rows. No test RF or XYZ is used for fitting, support selection or hyperparameter selection.
support: One genuine target fingerprint per distinct training position. Eligibility requires at least three observed APs also measured by source phones at the exact tagged coordinate. Seeds choose a nested ordered prefix up to16 eligible positions. Each fold/seed support order is captured before fits. No copies, simulated offsets or artificial device profiles.
pair_semantics: Supervised co-location matching by site, exact reference XYZ and AP identity across sequential device campaigns. These are not simultaneous channel views. Estimated offsets include device/day/body/environment confounds and are not an identified analog-front-end inverse.
zero_shot: N=0 uses no target-device fitting rows. Identity correction is reported as zero-support. Source baselines are computed once per phone and reused across support sizes/seeds without adding independent observations.
training_seed_scope: kNN references and closed-form ridge are deterministic fits. The three seeds are independently sampled target-support experiments, not three independently pretrained neural models. Nonzero-support calibration parameters are fitted separately for every draw. No neural model is trained in this track.
missingness: The +100 RSSI marker is unknown, represented by an explicit heard mask and inert numeric zero. kNN compares only APs observed in both records and requires three shared APs. No universal detection threshold or censored power is invented.
knn: Distance is shared-AP RSSI RMSE in dB. Choose up to5 finite neighbors with stable source-row tie ordering, weight by1/(distance+1), and average their reference XYZ. If none qualify, return the source-reference coordinate centroid and count the fallback.
ridge: Fit train-only per-AP mean/std over heard values, with std floor1dB. Missing normalized power is zero and a separate heard mask is appended. Center features and source XYZ for an unpenalized intercept; fit deterministic ridge with alpha10. No target/test values determine the normalizer. Ridge does not invoke the kNN shared-AP fallback, and its zero fallback count is not a coverage guarantee.
data_relocation: DEVICE_TRANSFER_DATA_ROOT selects a directory containing byte-identical7641701-DATASET.zip; CLI --archive also accepts an explicit path. Exact source SHA256 is always checked. Paths do not change splits, input identities or learned parameters.
calibration: For each support position/AP heard by target and source, subtract the median source-device RSSI at that exact position. Global correction is the median residual across valid position/AP pairs. AP correction shrinks its median residual to the global correction with n/(n+4). Apply corrections only to heard target values; retain missingness and all outliers. No clipping or test-driven tuning.
fitting_order: Register/publish source, protocol, training-only inventory and support orders. Fit and save all source references/ridge coefficients/calibrations first. Then load test RSSI and phone-ID metadata without XYZ, save all predictions and a before-label receipt, then open private XYZ and verify global train/test position disjointness before computing metrics.
aggregation: Report every phone/support draw and balanced phone-level means. Seeds/rows/APs are not independent sites. All five phones share one floor/site, and source folds overlap. No global significance or cross-building/warehouse service claim; all intervals/spread are descriptive.
prior_data_access: The public acquisition audit already inspected corpus shapes, missingness and aggregate test statistics, without fitting models or computing localization metrics. This is a pre-fit registration for a public benchmark, not an untouched secret test corpus.
activation: Offline real-data transfer probe only. No physical actuation, RadioJEPA objective attribution, warehouse service qualification, promotion, default change, global SOTA or universal device claim. Preserve all prior475 source and5161 evidence members unchanged.
